recent_reviews.title: Phenomenal Experience from Start to Finish!
recent_reviews.body: I cannot recommend Eden enough for anyone looking for a reliable, professional, and seamless way to receive Tirzepatide. Every aspect of their service has exceeded my expectations:The Providers: The medical team and customer service staff are highly professional, compassionate, and incredibly responsive. They made the virtual consultation and approval process simple, clear, and completely stress-free.The Product: The quality of the Tirzepatide is excellent. It has been highly effective for my health journey, and I feel confident knowing it is sourced reliably.The Delivery: Shipping is consistently fast, discreet, and perfectly packaged. My orders arrive right on schedule with all the necessary supplies securely included.If you are looking for a trustworthy online company with top-tier care, flat-rate transparent pricing, and excellent delivery, Eden is the absolute best choice!

recent_reviews.title: Not Happy With Customer Service
recent_reviews.body: I have been using semaglutide for awhile and I was on vacation for three weeks. My last does was the end of April. I was told that I have to start from the absolute beginning again since it was a lapse in treatment. I feel like that is just taking my money because it takes a while to ramp up from the beginning to where I was at. Is it possible to get compensated for 1 month for miscommunication on having to start from the beginning again? Thanks I was told due to cancellation policy, I'm not eligible for a refund. That is find except they should have reached out to me before they just decided to take my money out of my account. If I would have known that I have to start from the beginning, I would have just cancelled the whole treatment. I am requesting a refund of 296 dollars.

recent_reviews.title: Nathalie Senerez was great but the hold time wasn’t
recent_reviews.body: Nathalie Senerez was very good at answering my questions. And was kind and patient and I appreciated being able to talk with her. The reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because I called but the wait time was over 35 minutes and I had to hang up. I called back shortly after that and encountered another hold time was again over 30 minutes. But I held on the second time and finally spoke with Nathalie, who was great.
